task.instruction: Find the red mug with the white logo inside the open basket.
task.target_description: the red mug with the white logo
task.qwen_direct_prompt: Find the single red mug with the white logo that is physically inside the open basket. Ignore the red mug outside or behind the basket. Report its tight visible bounding box using relative image coordinates from 0 to 1000. Output exactly one JSON list in this form: [{"bbox_2d":[x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max],"label":"target"}]. bbox_2d MUST contain exactly four integer values, with x_min < x_max and y_min < y_max. If the target cannot be located reliably, output exactly: []. Do not include analysis, Markdown, polygons, points, masks, or extra numbers.

limitations: The basket is a locally available textured LIBERO scan; the red mugs remain procedural.
Only deterministic seed 0 and three validated simulated UR10e wrist views are evaluated.
The scanned basket is visual-only in this perception pilot and does not yet have collision geometry.
Qwen and detector scores are uncalibrated pilot values.
This is perception and view-motion validation only, not a belief-space MPC or final paper evaluation.
